about: One panel per story beat; the owner approves REAL frames rendered from the built scene (storyboard-frames.mjs).

panels.camera: low at the crane hook, tilt up with the ball
panels.action: Pete winches a giant golden ball up the skinny tower's side on a groaning crane; it swings and bonks the wall; a window pops out and a pigeon faints off the ledge; the ball keeps rocking
panels.narration: Pete just hung a giant golden ball inside his skyscraper.

panels.camera: continuous pull-back and rise to show the tower scale
panels.action: the camera pulls back: the tower is tall and skinny, Pete tiny; the banner OPENING TOMORROW flaps; next door Rex's crew builds a bigger copy and Rex waves sarcastically; the ball hangs through the top floors; Rex mimes a tiny violin
panels.narration: You see, the tower is tall and skinny, and it opens tomorrow.

panels.camera: slow push-in on Pete and the empty wallet
panels.action: Pete opens his empty wallet at the foot of the tower; the ball has taken the whole top floor where a TOP FLOOR FOR SALE sign hangs crossed out; a fly buzzes out of the wallet; the ball swings and its shadow crosses the crossed-out sign
panels.narration: But the ball ate the penthouse that was going to pay for it.

panels.camera: slow orbit round Rex tower then follow the dive
panels.action: Rex's sleek tower rises on the next plot with a rooftop pool and no ball; a crane drops the last glass panel; Rex dives off a diving board into the pool just to show off
panels.narration: So, of course, his rival builds a sleek copy, minus the silly ball.

panels.camera: dissolve to night; side-on push inside the top floor, then wide exterior lean
panels.action: night wind test: a gale hits, the tower leans, the too-short rope makes the ball bang about out of step, the dummy in the top-floor chair is flung; the dummy comes back wrapped in a curtain, dizzy, a window frame around its neck
panels.narration: But the night before opening, a gale sends his test dummy flying.

panels.camera: camera under the drilled hole looking up, orbit
panels.action: at night Pete drills a hole through the floor and lets the rope out; the ball sinks floor by floor, then he stops after three floors, afraid to cut more; plaster rains on him; the ball hangs three floors lower, still a bit short
panels.narration: And he can't miss the opening, so he drills through every floor and lowers the ball.

panels.camera: same shot pushes in on the I THINK sign
panels.action: Pete peeks through the drilled hole at the ball, shrugs and holds up a hand-lettered sign: I THINK; the ball sways a little and the sign flips upside down
panels.narration: Does he know what he's doing? Not really.

panels.camera: low follow of Rex with a torch, then moonlit wide of the long ball
panels.action: Rex laughs, sneaks into Pete's tower with a torch and cranks the winch until the ball sinks deep to smash the floor; he grins and tiptoes off; the ball now hangs exactly long: it swings slow and wide in the moonlight and touches nothing
panels.narration: His rival laughs, then sneaks in and cranks the winch until the ball hangs deep, so it will smash the floor.

panels.camera: dissolve to morning; high crane shot down the queue
panels.action: bright morning: the town queues around Rex's tower under a GRAND OPENING banner; kids point at its rooftop pool; the pool sloshes as a diver bounces; Pete's tower stands almost empty with one sad balloon
panels.narration: The next morning, the whole town queues for the rival's rooftop pool.

panels.camera: side track up the glass elevators
panels.action: Rex rides his elevator up first and waves from the roof; Pete steps into his elevator; a flag stands straight out with the first gust; Rex's elevator door shuts on his tie; Pete's doors close with a gust whistling in
panels.narration: Rex rides up first to show off, while Pete steps into his, and the wind arrives.

panels.camera: POV from inside the elevator, push to the ball
panels.action: in Pete's elevator the floor trembles; through a glass wall he sees the ball hanging deep, swinging slow as the tower begins to lean; his coffee cup slides and he braces: dread on his face
panels.narration: As the tower leans, he sees the ball hanging deep. But it's too late.

panels.camera: orbit the swing, whip-pan up to the tower
panels.action: a girl on a playground swing by the tower: her dad pushes in time and she flies, then pushes back against her and she stops dead; the camera swings up to the tower and the golden ball moving against it; the swing freezes mid-air with her cheerful face and the tower stops leaning
panels.narration: You see, a tall tower sways like a slow swing, and pushing back against a swing stops it.

panels.camera: parallel to the rope, pull back (ghost replay with blue glow)
panels.action: a ghost replay of the night test: the short rope's ball swings fast out of step and flings the dummy, then the long rope's ball swings slowly against the sway; a glow runs along the rope; the replayed dummy lands gently in its chair
panels.narration: A ball on a long rope swings slowly, against the tower, which is why the short rope threw the dummy.

panels.camera: push on the coffee on the desk, then wide
panels.action: Pete's tower stands still in the gust while the ball swings against it; the coffee on his desk stays flat; Pete floats out of the elevator without a spill and sips; the crowd gasps
panels.narration: So his coffee never spills, because the ball soaks up every sway.

panels.camera: wide from the crowd, shake with the sway
panels.action: Rex's tower with no ball sways more and more; the rooftop pool sloshes higher with each swing and slops over the edge; the whole pool dumps over the roof edge in a wave onto the crowd's side and onto the entrance where Rex has just stepped out
panels.narration: And the rival's tower, with no ball, sways until its pool slops over the roof.

panels.camera: push in on Rex, Pete winks behind
panels.action: close on Rex, soaked, green and seasick with a floating pool noodle round his neck; Pete in the background winks, mug raised; Rex wobbles and sits down in a puddle; a rubber duck floats past
panels.narration: Just as Rex steps out, soaked and seasick.
